## Gumroad -> Airtable: backfill & reconcile
* **Manual run** = import ALL past sales once.
* **Nightly** = re-check the last 3 days. Catches any ping Gumroad dropped (Gumroad retries a failed ping only 4 times, then gives up).

Upsert on Sale ID, so running it 10 times still gives one row per sale.
Needs credential *Gumroad API* (access token from Gumroad > Settings > Advanced > Applications).

nodes.name: Normalize & validate
nodes.notes: Same code as the live workflow. Merges duplicates inside the run.

nodes.name: Airtable: upsert by Sale ID
nodes.notes: Create or Update, merge on 'Sale ID' = idempotent. Same sale twice -> same row.
